description: This file defines the AdministrationDAO interface which specifies database methods for managing global properties and executing SQL within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes method signatures for retrieving, saving, deleting global properties, executing SQL queries, and other administrative database operations.

classes.name: AdministrationDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database operations related to application-wide configuration properties and system-level database actions within OpenMRS.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a global property by its name.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyObject
methods.description: Fetches the GlobalProperty object associated with the given property name.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Returns a list of all global properties defined in the system.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a GlobalProperty by its UUID.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves global properties whose names start with the specified prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Retrieves global properties whose names end with the specified suffix.

methods.name: deleteGlobalProperty
methods.description: Deletes a specified GlobalProperty from the database.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Persists a GlobalProperty object to the database.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL query, optionally restricted to select statements, and returns results.

methods.name: getMaximumPropertyLength
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed length for a property field based on its class and name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an object using Spring Errors, possibly for custom constraints.

methods.name: isDatabaseStringComparisonCaseSensitive
methods.description: Indicates whether the database performs case-sensitive string comparisons.

methods.name: updatePostgresSequence
methods.description: Updates PostgreSQL sequences as necessary, likely for synchronization.
